name: Kurata Karin
source:
She is always a calm and easy-going schoolgirl. She has been working part-time as a waitress at a coffee shop called “Lamp Eye." 

She is a bit naive, easily fooled by lies, and often takes them seriously. She always receives confessions of love but turns them down easily because she's an airhead.

She is best friends with Nagisa who is worried about her naivete, but it seems that she takes care of Nagisa much more often than not.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=222205&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
